claims.evidence: No photo shows origin, branding, or seller identity.
Photos show a used engine on concrete but no country of origin or import documents.
The report lists whether the engine runs or turns over as not shown.
Internal condition and running sound are not shown in photos.
Mileage cannot be read from an engine alone; no odometer or records shown.
No seal, gasket, or service-record photos are shown to prove it was never opened.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or turn over.
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking or running with no abnormal noise.

risks.risk: Internal damage or knock may exist.
risks.proof: Compression test results or borescope video of cylinder bores and valves.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a full rebuild.

risks.proof: Service records, import documents, or donor-vehicle odometer photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage or unknown wear.

risks.risk: Year, make, model, and vehicle compatibility are unknown.
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine block casting numbers, VIN plate from donor car, or part number stamp.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as fitment uncertain; may not match buyer's vehicle.

risks.risk: ECU, gearbox, or accessories may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing every included item together with the engine and any serial numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine block only, no ECU or gearbox.

risks.proof: Receipts, repair invoices, or import paperwork.
Written warranty or return policy from the seller.

proof_requests: Video of the engine turning over and running.
Compression test or borescope video of the cylinders.
Photo of engine block casting numbers and any visible VIN or part number.
Photo showing all included accessories, ECU, and gearbox if any.
Service records or import documents from Belgium.
response.reason: The witness identifies a used car engine, so a worst-case price is possible; all seller performance and origin claims remain unproven.
